visualCharacteristics.purpose: Boxed expandable question teaser (default), framed image + text promo (grey) and framed icon-link row (shadow)

contentPattern.structure: default: first cell is the question; the remaining cells or rows are the answer (text, links), or a single link to a /fragments/ path that is loaded on first expand. grey: one row with an image cell and a text cell (heading, text, CTA). shadow: one row of cells, each an icon + link

usage: Single FAQ teaser questions on claims and FAQ pages (23 pages); a resilience promo panel; a quick-actions icon link bar on the CTP page.
reuseGuidance: Use the default for one standalone expandable question; use an accordion block for a list of questions. `grey` is an image + text promo in a framed box; `shadow` is a framed row of icon links.
